summary: Read a square grid whose side length N is at most 50. The number stored in a cell tells how many cubes of edge length 1 are stacked on that cell, and each stored number lies between 0 and 50. When two cubes share a face, those two faces are covered and no longer exposed. Write the total area of every face that stays exposed after the stacking is finished.
notes: The left column is this sample's input text and the right column is the text the program should print. Comparison ignores trailing newlines.
